item.title: mbedtls_2: drop
item.description:
EOL (support end 2024) and that's not a good state for a TLS library. Marked as vulnerable since NixOS 25.11.

We still have a few – mostly EOL – packages using mbedtls_2. Those are dropped here as well. ustream-ssl-mbedtls supports mbedtls 3, so this gets used.
